Jules T: Quick sync 1: ran an int8-lite candidate v4-int8 shadow vs anchor v3.2-fp16 on multi-doc QA slice in staging. overall accuracy ticked up but low-confidence bucket and contradiction tail regressed.
Priya N: numbers and slices?
Jules T: TL;DR: accuracy_mean +0.3 pts, calib_p95 -2.6 pts, contradiction_rate +1.3ppt concentrated on low-confidence queries (<0.6). samples_lowconf: 340.
Jules T: ```
anchor: v3.2-fp16
candidate: v4-int8
metrics:
  accuracy_mean: 0.702 -> 0.705
  calib_p95: 0.780 -> 0.754
  contradiction_rate_lowconf: 0.009 -> 0.022
samples_lowconf: 340
```
Marco V: that's a significant tail move for low counts. reproducible?
Jules T: re-ran with fresh shadowing and a 36h sampling window; direction is consistent, p95 calib delta ~ -2.4 to -2.8. attention heatmaps for late tokens show small softmax rounding differences (maybe quant rounding in attention logits).
Patch-bot: shadow-run 9001 finished; artifacts uploaded to /runs/9001 (metrics + per-sample diffs + heatmaps).
Priya N: what's the staged-rollout/gating config we used for ring promotion? want to see smoothing and thresholds.
Jules T: current staged policy (ringed 10/50/100) uses conservative majority smoothing:
```
window: 4h
metrics: [calib_p95, contradiction_rate, accuracy_mean]
thresholds: {calib_drop: 0.02, contradiction_inc: 0.01}
smoothing: bucket_majority_3
contiguous_required: 2
promotion_mode: ringed (10% -> 50% -> 100%)
```
Jules T: Given the low-count longtail noise I'm proposing a slice-aware leash rule that adds EWMA smoothing for confidence slices, a sample-guard multiplier, and a softer progression pause (instead of full immediate fallback) for ring stages. Draft below.
Jules T: ```
name: confidence_slice_ewma_leash
triggers:
  - metric: calib_p95
    comparator: delta_lt
    threshold: 0.02
    smoothing: ewma_hl_6h
  - metric: contradiction_rate_lowconf
    comparator: delta_gt
    threshold: 0.01
  - sample_guard:
      when_count_lt: 500
      multiplier: 1.5
  - attention_variance_check: true
  - anchor_divergence_log: embedding_cosine
hysteresis:
  contiguous_buckets: 3
  cooldown: 15m
actions:
  - pause_progress (halts ring promotion at current step)
  - softpage: page Ops-oncall when contradiction_rate_lowconf > 0.015
  - if triggers persist after 2 windows: immediate-fallback
```
Priya N: I like the pause_progress action. lets not fully fallback on noisy slices unless persistent. Also good to softpage early.
Marco V: +1 on adding anchor_embedding_divergence and per-slice attention-variance. that'll help separate covariate shift from quantization error.
Patch-bot: created issue ML-9009: "confidence_slice_ewma_leash + pause-progression" assigned to @Jules T.
Ops-oncall: FYI please add a short runbook entry: page for contradiction_rate_lowconf > 0.015 and include the /runs/9001 artifact link.
Jules T: will open PR to add this rule to staged-canary and enable EWMA smoothing for confidence slices, then run an extended 48h shadow with the new policy. will attach a 100-sample failing set and a repro script for attention-rundown.
Priya N: can you request infra to block further ring promotions until the rule lands?
Marco V: I'll review the PR today, aim to merge once artifacts look reproducible. :thumbsup:
Jules T: plan: hold progression until EWMA leash is in place and extended shadow finishes; if pause_progress triggers we'll investigate attention rounding on candidate and then decide whether to continue or fallback.
Priya N: thanks for flagging early, this is exactly the gated bring-up behaviour we want.
